title: Decision: Exponential backoff with 3600s cap
description: outbox.rs line 98 implements retry backoff as delay = min(60 * 2^attempt, 3600). This caps the max delay at 1 hour (never longer), preventing permanent silence after many failures. The formula is: attempt 0→60s, 1→120s, 2→240s, ... 6→3840s (capped at 3600s), 7+→3600s. Rejected alternatives: linear backoff would delay too quickly to early failures; no cap would cause indefinite silencing.
